objects.name: SCENE_VDP_INDIRECT_ZERO_FILL_STREAM
objects.behavior: The FFFF escape follows pointer 0x00002A48, making the ten-byte source a repeating zero-word stream for the 0x200-word transfer.

conclusion: The former 0x00002A44-0x00002A51 layout gap is two adjacent, bounded scene-VDP objects: an eight-byte fixed header followed by a ten-byte indirect zero-fill source stream.
